description: Join the in-person Gurugram team building ARPM's visual programming language and next-generation development environment. You will own slices of a live C# / .NET product spanning a headless graph engine, a cross-platform editor, backend and session transport, plugins and host interop, and AI-assisted authoring - design, implement, test, and ship. **What you'll do** * Extend the execution model: components, ports, wires, events, validation, and error propagation. * Improve the editor: canvas behaviour, responsiveness, and the line between local interaction and server sync. * Keep a strict split between core computation, transport, and UI - the engine should run headless. * Ship plugins and host-side runtimes so one graph can target Rhino, Revit, Unity, and similar applications. * Write tests that exercise runtime behaviour - event ordering, cross-thread events, and data-plus-event graphs - not only isolated functions. * Help design how agents propose graph edits, and how those edits are judged against explicit evaluations. * Work across ASP.NET, gRPC, and related transports between the editor, compute workers, and host runtimes. * Read existing architecture before adding surface area, then own the slice through to ship. **What we're looking for** * Professional fluency in C# and .NET. This is a C# product - this is not a pick-up-C#-on-the-job role. * Comfort with systems software, not only CRUD apps: graph data structures, execution order, concurrency, serialisation, plugin loading, and clear module boundaries. * Ability to work in a multi-process / client-server product (editor, backend, compute hosts) and decide what belongs on which side of the wire. * Solid git hygiene, willingness to write unit and behavioural tests, and the habit of reading before rewriting. * Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to discuss design trade-offs in person. * Comfort working full-time on-site in Gurugram. This is not a remote or hybrid-by-default role; relocate to NCR if you are not already here. * Demonstrated work. A computer-science degree is not required. * Willingness to show skill through an open-ended assignment or a research/prototype proposal you suggest - we do not hire on timed algorithm drills. **Nice to have** * AEC technology: Grasshopper, RhinoCommon, Revit API, Dynamo, ShapeDiver, Speckle, or shipping plugins and configurators. * AI agent loops: tool-calling agents, MCP servers or clients, eval harnesses, or spec-driven agentic products - not only using a chatbot. * IDE / language tooling: editors, language servers, compilers, REPLs, debuggers, node canvases, or developer-tool UX. * Visual / dataflow programming: node-wire environments, event-driven runtimes, or comparable graph UIs. * Avalonia, WPF, canvas/Skia, WebAssembly, gRPC, Protocol Buffers, or ASP.NET Core. * C++, Unity, Python for embedding, or collaborative editing (CRDT or OT).

ai_summary.why: Strong C#/.NET fluency and experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and high-throughput data processing align well with this role.
ai_summary.gaps: Limited experience with AI agents, graph data structures, and specific C# product development tools like Rhino/Revit.

description: About This Role Your team Modern Workplace Engineering delivers and operates enterprise workplace technologies that enable secure and reliable access across managed devices. The team engineers and supports enterprise mobile services, with a strong focus on Apple iOS and iPadOS and hands-on ownership across Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) and Microsoft Intune. The team partners across security, identity, network, application and service-management functions to improve platform reliability, automation and the overall mobile experience. Your role and impact As an Associate in Modern Workplace Engineering, you will be an individual contributor responsible for delivering mobile-platform engineering and operational improvements from design through production support. You will help evolve enterprise mobile services by strengthening device-management capabilities, improving automation, resolving complex technical issues and supporting secure integration with identity, networking and adjacent platforms. iOS and iPadOS engineering will be the primary technical focus, with macOS and Jamf experience contributing to broader Apple-platform capabilities. The role combines engineering delivery with steady-state service ownership and cross-functional collaboration. Your responsibilities Responsibilities In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: Engineer and operate enterprise mobile management services across Ivanti EPMM and Microsoft Intune, including enrollment, configuration, compliance, application management, testing, controlled releases, platform standards and technical documentation. Own the mobile-platform service lifecycle, delivering engineering backlog items and Level 3 troubleshooting while supporting controlled environments, incident and problem management, knowledge transfer and reliable day-to-day operations. Develop secure, supportable automation and reporting using PowerShell and other appropriate scripting, application programming interface (API) and source-control capabilities to reduce manual effort, improve data quality and increase visibility of platform health and performance. Lead iOS and iPadOS engineering and contribute to broader Apple-platform capabilities, including device enrollment, managed applications, certificates, macOS and Jamf collaboration, automation and lifecycle standards. Partner across security, identity, network, application and service-management teams to deliver secure and resilient mobile services, manage dependencies and communicate technical risks, decisions and status to stakeholders. Your experience Demonstrated experience in enterprise endpoint, mobility or modern workplace engineering, including hands-on enterprise mobile management and strong iOS and iPadOS engineering capabilities. Experience engineering enterprise device enrollment, configuration, compliance, managed applications, reporting and device lifecycle processes. Practical experience with scripting, automation, APIs and controlled source-management practices, including PowerShell and relevant experience with Python, shell scripting, Git or Azure DevOps. Strong Apple enterprise-management experience, with iOS and iPadOS as the primary focus and additional macOS or Jamf experience beneficial. Understanding of enterprise identity, certificate, network and secure-access technologies and their integration with endpoint-management services, including Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI). Strong troubleshooting, engineering ownership, documentation and communication capabilities in complex enterprise environments, with experience supporting service improvements or significant platform changes beneficial. Experience with enterprise automation, service-management, security or operational-reporting platforms is beneficial, as is experience in regulated environments and relevant endpoint-management certifications. Our Benefits To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. Our hybrid work model BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. Guidance on AI use for candidates At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. About BlackRock At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok. BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

description: **Company Overview** The world is moving towards an autonomous future where sooner or later everything that is driven, pushed or pulled today, will be moving by itself. At Flo Mobility, we believe that the true adaptation of autonomy lies in the seamless coexistence of humans and bots. By leveraging the power of sensors, computer vision, edge computing, and actuators, we optimize this relationship to deliver the best speed, agility, comfort and control. Our hero product, FLO Hauler, is an Autonomous Electric Material mover, helping customers reduce time and cost of moving material across Construction, Agriculture, Mining and Warehousing industries. Flo Hauler is being used by industry leaders like L&T, PSP, Total Environment to gain 50% savings on cost and time for the last mile of material movement. Our solutions are offered on Raas (Robot-as-a-service) model. The no capex approach makes it easy for our clients to adopt our MMRs (Material Movement Robots). **Role Overview** We are looking for a Firmware Engineer with 1 to 2 years of hands-on experience to join our robotics team and build the next generation of autonomous systems. You will design, develop, and debug embedded firmware that controls and communicates with our MMRs and autonomous platforms, working closely with electronics, mechanical, software, and systems engineers. This role offers real ownership of production-grade firmware on robots deployed in the field, along with the chance to deepen your expertise in STM32, ESP32, CAN, and robotics communication stacks. You will collaborate with firmware and cross-functional engineering teams to troubleshoot hardware-software issues, optimize system performance, and develop robust firmware for production-grade robotic platforms. **Responsibilities** **Embedded Firmware Development:** Design, develop, and maintain firmware in C/C++ for robotics platforms, primarily on STM32 and ESP32 microcontrollers. **STM32 Development:** Use STM32CubeIDE, STM32CubeMX, HAL, and CMSIS for peripheral configuration, driver development, hardware bring-up, and debugging. **ESP32 Development:** Build embedded applications using PlatformIO, Arduino framework, or ESP-IDF, including sensor integration, wireless connectivity, and system-level firmware. **Peripheral Interfacing:** Develop and debug drivers for GPIO, UART, SPI, I2C, ADC, DAC, PWM, timers, interrupts, DMA, and watchdogs. **CAN Communication:** Implement and debug CAN-based communication between STM32 controllers, motor controllers, sensors, and other embedded nodes, including frame design, IDs, baud rates, filtering, termination, and error handling. **Protocol & Sensor Integration:** Integrate sensors, motor drivers, displays, and other devices over UART, I2C, SPI, CAN, RS485, and similar interfaces. Exposure to higher-level protocols such as Modbus or CANopen is a plus. **Debugging & Diagnostics:** Debug firmware and hardware issues using ST-LINK/SWD, JTAG, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, CAN analyzers, and serial terminals. Analyze logs, reproduce field issues, and drive problems to root cause. **Python Tooling & Automation:** Write Python scripts for firmware testing, log analysis, CAN/serial data parsing, test automation, and diagnostic tools. **Testing & Validation:** Create test procedures, perform functional and integration testing, and validate firmware against system requirements. **Firmware Architecture:** Design modular, non-blocking, interrupt-driven firmware with state machines, fault handling, and clean driver abstractions. **Cross-functional Collaboration:** Work with electronics, mechanical, and software teams to resolve hardware-software integration issues and improve system performance. **Version Control & Releases:** Use Git for branching, merging, code reviews, and maintaining versioned firmware releases. Contribute to documentation of firmware design and release notes. **Education Background** Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech.) in Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE), Instrumentation Engineering, or a related field. Relevant certifications in Firmware Design (ESP32, STM32,Arduino), Embedded Systems **Skills** 1. 1 to 2 years of hands-on experience in embedded firmware development 2. Strong fundamentals in Embedded C/C++ (pointers, structures, enums, bit manipulation, memory management, interrupts) 3. Hands-on experience with STM32 microcontrollers using STM32CubeIDE / STM32CubeMX, HAL, and CMSIS 4. Hands-on experience with ESP32 (PlatformIO, Arduino framework, or ESP-IDF) 5. Solid understanding of UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, ADC, PWM, timers, interrupts, and DMA 6. Practical experience with CAN protocol: frames, standard/extended IDs, arbitration, baud rates, acceptance filters, and error handling 7. Proficiency in Python for scripting, tooling, and test automation 8. Strong debugging skills using ST-LINK/SWD, JTAG, breakpoints, watchpoints, register inspection, and serial logs 9. Comfortable with lab equipment: oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, bench power supplies, and CAN/serial analyzers 10. Proficiency with Git (repositories, branches, merges, tags, releases) **What We Look For** 1. A strong foundation in embedded C/C++, microcontrollers, communication protocols, and basic electronics 2. A debugging mindset: the ability to analyze logs, reproduce failures, find root causes, and fix issues on real hardware 3. Candidates who have shipped STM32/ESP32 projects, CAN-based systems, sensor or motor-controller interfaces, or other embedded products will be preferred 4. Hands-on experience and the ability to solve real hardware/firmware problems are valued more than purely theoretical knowledge 5. Ownership, curiosity, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-moving robotics startup

description: **About the Role** We are looking for a skilled Hardware Design Engineer with hands-on experience in schematic design, multi-layer PCB development, power electronics and motor controller systems. The candidate should have practical knowledge of hardware design, testing, debugging and manufacturing. **Key Responsibilities** 1. Design and develop electronic schematics for STM32 and ESP32-based platforms. 2.Design and develop multi-layer PCBs using KiCad, Altium Designer or EasyEDA. 3. Select and analyze electronic components such as MCUs, MOSFETs, IGBTs, gate drivers and regulators. 4. Design DC-DC converters (Buck, Boost and Buck-Boost). 5. Develop high-power BLDC and DC motor driver circuits. 6. Implement CAN, SPI, I2C and UART communication interfaces. 7. Ensure proper signal integrity, power integrity and EMI/EMC management. 8. Perform hardware bring-up, testing, debugging and troubleshooting. 9. Prepare Gerber files, BOMs and manufacturing documentation. 10. Maintain hardware design revisions and documentation using Git. **Required Skills & Qualifications** 1. Bachelor's degree in ECE, EEE or a related engineering field. 2. Hands-on experience in PCB design and schematic development. 3. Proficiency in KiCad, Altium Designer or EasyEDA. 4. Knowledge of STM32 and ESP32 microcontrollers. 5. Strong understanding of power electronics and DC-DC converters. 6. Experience with BLDC/DC motor controllers and gate driver circuits. 7. Knowledge of MOSFETs, IGBTs and power management circuits. 8. Understanding of CAN, SPI, I2C and UART protocols. 9. Experience with oscilloscopes, multimeters and logic analyzers. 10. Knowledge of PCB manufacturing, DFM and EMI/EMC. **Preferred Candidate Profile** 1. Practical experience in multi-layer PCB design. 2. Experience in high-power electronics and motor control systems. 3. Strong hardware debugging and problem-solving skills. 4. Ability to independently handle hardware development from design to testing

Read and understand engineering drawings and technical specifications. Monitor manpower, materials, and equipment at project sites. Assist in measurements, quantity calculations, and material requirements. Ensure work is carried out as per approved drawings and instructions. Follow company safety procedures and quality standards. Prepare and maintain project-related documentation. Coordinate with the engineering and project execution teams. RequirementsTechnical Skills Basic knowledge of Civil Engineering concepts. Understanding of construction activities and site execution. Ability to read and understand engineering drawings. Basic knowledge of AutoCAD and MS Excel. Knowledge of quantity estimation and measurements. Good documentation and reporting skills. Candidate Requirements Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering. 0–2 years of relevant experience. Freshers can also apply. Good communication and coordination skills. Willingness to learn and take responsibility. Candidates should be willing to travel to project sites if required.
